text:
Maria: quick async standup — onboarding + eval pass. what I did / blockers / today
Maria: done: onboarded sylph-13b-q to staging and ran full eval on promptset customer-support-v2. overall accuracy dropped 87.1% -> 85.2%, mainly on spanish/date prompts.
Maria: blockers: kv-cache shadow failing for longctx regen — generation truncates at ~2048 even though KV warmup reports full cache. suspect tokenizer mismatch for ¿ and inverted punctuation.
Ben: thx for the heads up. re: tokenizer — I saw a similar flip on 13b-xxl last month. can you run `python tools/token-check.py --model sylph-13b-q --prompt "¿Cómo"` and paste output?
Maria: running now, will paste results in a sec. also pinging @Kai for CR on quant merge PR #482 (small schedule tweak).
Kai: ack — I can review in ~30m. quick note: the quant scheduler change has one nit (batch boundary) but nothing blocking merge.
Olga: fyi the eval runner flagged a quality regression on the "es_date_tokens" bucket (+3.8 hallucination rate). I queued a focused rerun with different seed and stricter scoring.
EvalBot: auto-eval: sylph-13b-q staging run finished — accuracy 85.2% (prev 87.1). regression buckets: es_date_tokens +3.8%, repetition +1.2%. detailed report: <internal://runs/1759994321>.
Maria: ok — plan: 1) Ben run tokenizer-check + patch if needed; 2) Kai merge quant CR but gate canary; 3) Olga confirm rerun results; 4) I will open a tiny promptset PR to remove ambiguous "llamar" variant and re-eval.
Ben: ran token-check — found 2 mismatches in byte mapping for inverted question mark and preceding whitespace on our byte-level tokenizer. pushing tiny fix to tokenizer-utils/patch-175 and will run smoke.
Ben: smoke results: tokenizer normalized, no truncation in local regen for longctx. I can run the full token-check across the promptset if you want.
Maria: please run full token-check across customer-support-v2 — if green, I'll re-run the staging eval.
Kai: CR review done. merging after green CI and will add a canary with reduced `batch_max_tokens` for 1h to avoid the p95 spike.
Chris: note from infra — canary currently shows elevated p95 for seq_len>2048 during heavy batching. recommend lowering canary `batch_max_tokens` from 65k -> 40k for the test window. I'll standby to flip it when you say go.
Maria: thanks. blockers resolved if Ben's full token-check is green and Olga's rerun doesn't show new regressions. today: run the full token-check, re-eval staging, and if smoke passes request canary rollout to dedicated.
Olga: rerun queued, ETA ~18m. I'll report pass/fail and diff of failing prompts.
Ben: full token-check completed — normalized mappings across promptset. pushing PR with patch + unit test: tokenizer-utils#177.
Maria: perfect — I'll kick the staging eval now. once smoke passes, Kai please flip the canary batch downsizing and Chris monitor p95.
Chris: got it. I'll watch and add a temporary alert if p95 > baseline +200ms.
Kai: will set up the reduced-batch canary and post the canary ID here before you promote.
Maria: thanks team. small ask: Ben, after this can you also run the normalization script over our spanish prompt variants to remove accent/no-accent duplicates? helps reduce noisy regressions.
Ben: yep — I'll run `tools/normalizer.fix_accents(customer-support-v2)` after this rollout.
Maria: great. if anyone hits blockers I’ll be online for the next hour. :thumbsup:
